shortDescription: 8-week four-day torso and limbs split for balanced upper-body and lower-body volume.
descriptionHtml:
8-week four-day torso and limbs split for balanced upper-body and lower-body volume.

Structure: 8 weeks, 4 scheduled sessions per week, 28 referenced exercise ids.

Weekly split: Torso #1, Limbs #1, Torso #2, and Limbs #2.

  • Goal: hypertrophy
  • Level: intermediate
  • Duration: 8 weeks
  • Tags: torso limbs and 4 days per week
